nodes.label: HDR PNG Read-Back Validation
nodes.rationale: A generated artifact is complete only after RGB16 type, cICP 9/16/0/1, clipping statistics, nits mapping, and a PQ round trip are verified.

nodes.label: DevKit Baseline Shader Equivalence
nodes.rationale: A decompiled shader first becomes a 1:1 live replacement and is compared at the same draw before HDR or tonemap changes are introduced.

nodes.label: DevKit Findings to Shipping Add-on
nodes.rationale: DevKit clones and hotswaps are proof only; validated resource upgrades and CRC-addressed shaders move into the game add-on.

nodes.label: Reproducible Dark-Theme Plot Artifacts
nodes.rationale: Analysis figures retain explicit units, normalization, source CSV, and scripts, with dark-theme output and fixed scales for comparable panels.

nodes.label: Explicit Test-Pattern Source Domain
nodes.rationale: Every controlled pattern identifies gamut, white point, transfer, scale, format, and clipping policy without silently normalizing maxima.
